boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten distinct, university-documented study environments in Mary Kintz Bevevino Library.

cards.title: Study Room 1
cards.subtitle: Mary Kintz Bevevino Library · first floor
cards.notes: Reserve this first-floor room for a working session that needs a six-seat whiteboard table and wall-sized whiteboard surface.
cards.short_summary: A reservable first-floor room built around shared whiteboard work.
cards.evidence_claim: Study Rooms 1–4 have whiteboard-surface tables seating six and at least one whiteboard-surface wall; students may reserve library study rooms.
cards.access_notes: Misericordia students have priority. Reserve with a Misericordia email for up to three hours; unreserved rooms are open for use.

cards.title: Study Room 2
cards.subtitle: Mary Kintz Bevevino Library · first floor
cards.notes: Book this six-seat first-floor room when your group wants to sketch, solve, and revise directly on the table and wall surfaces.
cards.short_summary: A first-floor collaborative room with two practical whiteboard surfaces.
cards.evidence_claim: Study Rooms 1–4 have whiteboard-surface tables seating six and at least one whiteboard-surface wall; students may reserve library study rooms.
cards.access_notes: Misericordia students have priority. Reserve with a Misericordia email for up to three hours; unreserved rooms are open for use.

cards.title: Study Room 3
cards.subtitle: Mary Kintz Bevevino Library · first floor
cards.notes: Use the six-seat whiteboard table for a collaborative outline or problem set, then erase and reset the room for the next group.
cards.short_summary: A first-floor room that supports tabletop and wall-based collaboration.
cards.evidence_claim: Study Rooms 1–4 have whiteboard-surface tables seating six and at least one whiteboard-surface wall; students may reserve library study rooms.
cards.access_notes: Misericordia students have priority. Reserve with a Misericordia email for up to three hours; unreserved rooms are open for use.

cards.title: Study Room 4
cards.subtitle: Mary Kintz Bevevino Library · first floor
cards.notes: Plan a group meeting here when a shared table for six and write-on surfaces will help you keep notes visible to everyone.
cards.short_summary: A reservable six-seat workspace for visible group thinking.
cards.evidence_claim: Study Rooms 1–4 have whiteboard-surface tables seating six and at least one whiteboard-surface wall; students may reserve library study rooms.

cards.title: Study Room 5
cards.subtitle: Mary Kintz Bevevino Library · first floor
cards.notes: Reserve this five-seat conference-table room for a presentation rehearsal or screen-based group task using its 70-inch AQUOS display.
cards.short_summary: A first-floor conference setup with a large ClickShare-enabled screen.
cards.evidence_claim: Study Room 5 has a five-seat conference table and a 70-inch AQUOS screen with ClickShare access.
cards.access_notes: Misericordia students have priority. Reserve with a Misericordia email for up to three hours; unreserved rooms are open for use.

cards.title: Study Room 6
cards.subtitle: Mary Kintz Bevevino Library · second floor
cards.notes: Choose this four-seat room when you need a screen for shared materials and a whiteboard wall for planning the next steps together.
cards.short_summary: A four-seat second-floor room pairing a whiteboard wall with a collaboration screen.
cards.evidence_claim: Study Rooms 6–13 have a whiteboard-surface wall, four-seat tables, and a screen for collaborative group work.
cards.access_notes: Misericordia students have priority. Reserve with a Misericordia email for up to three hours; unreserved rooms are open for use.

cards.title: Study Room 7
cards.subtitle: Mary Kintz Bevevino Library · second floor
cards.notes: Set up a four-person collaboration here, using the screen for documents or slides and the whiteboard wall to track decisions as you work.
cards.short_summary: A compact group room for screen sharing and whiteboard planning.
cards.evidence_claim: Study Rooms 6–13 have a whiteboard-surface wall, four-seat tables, and a screen for collaborative group work.
cards.access_notes: Misericordia students have priority. Reserve with a Misericordia email for up to three hours; unreserved rooms are open for use.

cards.title: Study Room 8
cards.subtitle: Mary Kintz Bevevino Library · second floor
cards.notes: Use the four-seat table for a focused team task, keeping reference material on the screen and working notes on the whiteboard wall.
cards.short_summary: A second-floor room organized for small-group research and review.
cards.evidence_claim: Study Rooms 6–13 have a whiteboard-surface wall, four-seat tables, and a screen for collaborative group work.
cards.access_notes: Misericordia students have priority. Reserve with a Misericordia email for up to three hours; unreserved rooms are open for use.

cards.entity_name: Center for Nursing History of Northeastern Pennsylvania
cards.title: Center for Nursing History of Northeastern Pennsylvania
cards.subtitle: Mary Kintz Bevevino Library · second floor
cards.notes: Reserve this multipurpose room when a change of setting helps; leave time to look at its collection cases before returning to your work.
cards.short_summary: A reservable second-floor room surrounded by nursing-history collection displays.
cards.evidence_claim: The Center for Nursing History is a multipurpose second-floor library space with collection cases, and students may reserve it through the study-room system.
cards.access_notes: Students may reserve the room through the study-room reservation system, but may be asked to relocate if Library or University staff need it.

cards.title: Second Floor Computer Lab
cards.subtitle: Mary Kintz Bevevino Library · second floor
cards.notes: Check whether instruction is underway, then use an available workstation for individual research, writing, or coursework that needs a campus computer.
cards.short_summary: An individual-use computer lab available outside library instruction sessions.
cards.evidence_claim: When it is not being used for library instruction, the Second Floor Computer Lab is available for student use; Misericordia students have priority.
cards.source_title: Second Floor Computer Lab - Misericordia University
cards.access_notes: Available when not in use for library instruction; it cannot be reserved for group study. Food is prohibited and only covered drinks are permitted.
